notes.title: Check Out the "Development" Branch for Latest Updates!
notes.content:
We're excited to share a sneak peek of our upcoming update. Head over to the "development" branch to experience the latest features before the official release.

What's New:


 Smog Loop: Smog is emitted every minute, simulating pollution from a technological factory. Players must strategically remove the smog to raise the temperature and melt the ice, securing vital water resources.
 Gene Mutations: Explore and select genetic mutations to enhance your mushrooms' abilities.

To access the development branch:

[olist]
 Go to Steam Properties for Mycelium Guardians
 Navigate to Properties -> Betas -> Beta Participation
 Select: Development
[/olist]

notes.title: Exciting Developments and a Transparent Update on Mycelium Guardians
notes.content:
Hello Guardians,
We have some important updates to share about the future of Mycelium Guardians. Our Kickstarter campaign has been approved, and we’re planning to launch in the coming months. This is a big step, and we want to approach it with honesty and clarity about our intentions and constraints.

A Team Effort with a Solo Drive
While we are a team passionate about Mycelium Guardians, I, Magic, am currently the only one working full-time on this project. Our goal remains steadfast: to complete and perfect Mycelium Guardians, making you truly feel like part of the fungal kingdom restoring life on a desolate planet.

Why Kickstarter?
The primary aim of this Kickstarter is to secure additional funding that will afford us more time to craft this experience thoughtfully and keep the scope manageable for our debut game. We want to ensure Mycelium Guardians not only launches but serves as a stepping stone for more creative projects in the future.

Your Guidance is Crucial
We are navigating this process and learning as we go, which means your feedback and support are more critical than ever. While Kickstarter is also a tool to raise awareness and confirm interest in Mycelium Guardians, it’s important to us that it doesn’t detract from our main goal: finishing a game that we all can be proud of.

About the Rewards
We’re focusing on digital rewards, including exclusive content like scanned notes, sketches, Blender 3D project files, and Godot 4 source files for early assets and prototypes. These rewards are designed to enrich your experience without overwhelming our development focus. Your input on these rewards and what you’d find valuable is eagerly welcomed.

Join Us on This Journey
Please stay tuned for more updates as we finalize the launch date and the details of the campaign. We invite you to share your thoughts, suggestions, and questions on our forums and social media. Your guidance is crucial to making this Kickstarter a success and ensuring Mycelium Guardians becomes the game we all envision.

Thank you for your passion, commitment, and understanding as we take this significant step together. Let’s make the world of Mycelium Guardians come alive!


click "Notify me on launch" 🔔 in Kickstarter page

notes.title: Early Access Launch: What’s Inside?
notes.content:
🌍 Hello everyone! In celebration of Earth Day, we launched our game in early access yesterday, building upon the foundation set by our initial demo. Here's what's new:

What’s Included in Early Access:

 Prologue & Tutorial: We've added a narrative prologue that doubles as a tutorial to help new players understand the basics while introducing them to the world of our game.
 Sandbox Mode: You can now experience a map where elements like smog, radiation, and water change with each playthrough. Note that ruins are currently static and will not change between sessions.

Why Try Early Access?

 Your feedback is incredibly important. Early access is a chance for you to help shape the game’s development by sharing your thoughts and experiences. If you’re interested in being part of this process, we’d love for you to join us.

Start with the Demo:

 We recommend starting with the demo to get a sense of what the game is about before diving into early access.

Ongoing Development:

 The game is still very much in development (current version 0.1.0). We’re working hard to add new features and polish existing ones. If you prefer to wait for a more finished product, please check back for our full release, version 1.0, coming soon.

We Need Your Feedback:

 Developing this game has been a largely solo journey, and real player feedback is crucial at this stage. Whether it’s criticism or praise, your honest opinions will help improve the game.

Was it too early for early access? Maybe.

 But it's also a valuable opportunity for community-driven development. Your insights are vital for us to refine and perfect the game.

Thank you for your support and for considering our game. Your input is not just appreciated—it’s essential!

notes.title: Join Mycelium Guardians on Patreon!
notes.content:
Welcome to the vibrant world of "Mycelium Guardians"! Today, we're thrilled to extend an invitation to our players and fans to join us on a new platform: Patreon.

Our Patreon page is a gateway for you to dive deeper into the creation of "Mycelium Guardians," offering a unique opportunity to support the game's ongoing development while getting exclusive access to behind-the-scenes content, updates, and the chance to shape the game's journey alongside us.

Why Patreon?
Patreon allows us to build a closer relationship with our community. Your support not only fuels the development of new features, improvements, and expansions but also enables us to engage with you directly, gather feedback, and incorporate your ideas into the game. It's about creating "Mycelium Guardians" together, ensuring it grows and evolves in ways that excite and satisfy our players.

What's in Store for Patrons?


 Exclusive Behind-the-Scenes Access: Sneak peeks at upcoming features, design insights, and development updates.
 Direct Influence: Vote on new content, features, and directions for the game.
 Early Access: Be the first to try new updates, features, and expansions.
 Special Recognition: Get your name in the game credits, receive special in-game items, and more.


Joining our Patreon is more than just supporting a game; it's joining a community of enthusiasts passionate about the unique world of "Mycelium Guardians" and its development. Whether you're here for the strategic depth, the environmental storytelling, or the innovative gameplay, your support on Patreon makes it all possible.

Check out our Patreon page here: https://www.patreon.com/MyceliumGuardians

We're incredibly excited about what the future holds and deeply grateful for your support. Together, let's make "Mycelium Guardians" the best game it can be!

Thank you for being a part of this journey.
